description: This file defines the AWS OpsWorksCMClient class, which is a PHP client for interacting with the AWS OpsWorks for Chef Automate service, including method signatures for service operations.

classes.name: OpsWorksCMClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for AWS OpsWorks for Chef Automate service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: associateNode
methods.description: Initiates the associate node operation for AWS OpsWorks CM.

methods.name: createBackup
methods.description: Creates a backup of server data.

methods.name: describeEvents
methods.description: Gets list of events for a server.

methods.name: describeNodeAssociationStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of node association.

methods.name: disassociateNode
methods.description: Disassociates a node from the server.
